output.title: BR-07 write-downs over 10% of a proposal wait for a billing manager's approval before it can be finalised @critical
output.data_choice: P-1051 is free, in EUR with no agreed or project rates, and has two approved, billable entries (8 h SNR at 150 and 6 h CONS at 120), so its value before adjustments is 1,920.00 and 10% is exactly 192.00. A -200 write-down is just over the limit, and -192 sits on it, which catches the approval coming back at or below 10%. This assumes 'value before adjustments' means the subtotal before tax, as the proposed test on P-1001 implies.
scenario: Create a proposal for P-1051 Atlas loyalty programme with period end 2026-10-31

Delete the proposal and accept the confirmation
